verdict.rationale: Missive has no CLI or headless runtime, but it can be driven without the UI through its REST API, webhooks and an official MCP server, and the changelog says drafts can be created through the API and MCP server. That makes scripted or CI-driven automation possible against the hosted service, built from API calls. Missing for 10: a CLI or documented headless/CI usage, CI-specific guides or examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
